name: Awards
description: Awards and nominations from Wikidata. A film's page gains a row of award circles beside its cast: who gave it, what for, and whether it was won or only nominated. A person's page lists their awards and shows which of the winning titles are already in your library. Needs no account and no API key.
author: Multipass

settings.label: Major ceremonies only
settings.help: Academy Awards, BAFTA, Golden Globes, Emmys, Screen Actors Guild, Cannes and Venice. Turn this off to show everything Wikidata holds, which for a well-known film runs to dozens of regional critics' prizes.

settings.label: Contact address
settings.help: Wikidata's query service asks every caller to identify itself, and throttles the ones that do not. An email or a URL is enough. Leave it blank and requests still work, just with a generic name and a lower rate limit.
